question: Should `agent-transcript` treat GitHub Copilot session-state logs as a supported source for public PR/issue transcript provenance once current-head redaction proof is supplied?
rationale: This is a new privacy-sensitive input boundary, so tests can demonstrate behavior but cannot determine the repository’s permanent source-admission policy.

options.title: Admit Copilot sessions with proof

options.title: Keep existing source scope
options.body: Decline Copilot discovery in the shared skill and leave the current supported local-session sources unchanged.
